name: RAN binding protein 2
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: RANBP2 encodes E3 SUMO-protein ligase RanBP2. Annotated molecular activities include SUMO ligase activity and SUMO transferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and centrosome localization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to familial acute necrotizing encephalopathy (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.

function.text: RANBP2 encodes E3 SUMO-protein ligase RanBP2. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and centrosome localization. Functional annotations also associate the protein with SUMO ligase activity and SUMO transferase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with familial acute necrotizing encephalopathy (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RANBP2 have been reported in epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and renal clear cell carcinoma.
